title: Store Update 1.28.0
body:
# Store Update 1.28.0

Raiders!

A new store rotation is now live, bringing in The Castaway Set. To get the update, restart the game or click the update prompt.

The Third Expedition is now underway, and the third and final update to the Patchwork outfit is now available to everyone who has departed in their Caravans.

To those beginning fresh adventures in the Rust Belt: good luck, and go claim those Blueprints, Raiders!

The team is aware that some expeditioners are ending up missing skill points after departing. The underlying issue has been fixed, but the team is still identifying the remaining affected accounts and will grant those missing skill points in the coming days.

See you topside,

//Ossen
